existing_features.title: Create a “Little Light Bible Stories” ebook experience containing exactly 20 stories starting from Creation, with an in-app reading experience (table of contents + story view) that works without requiring users to download the PDF.
Provide an ebook export feature that generates one combined, downloadable PDF containing all 20 stories in order, including each story’s illustration and a kid-friendly coloring page.
Add automatic audio narration for each story, playable inside the app, with basic playback controls (play/pause, restart, and progress display).
Include automatically generated illustrated images for each story and kid-friendly coloring pages (coloring-book style line art) throughout the ebook/app, and store them as static frontend assets.

Apply a cohesive, kid-friendly visual theme for “Little Light Bible Stories” across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling), avoiding blue/purple as primary colors unless required by content.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create “Little Light Bible Stories” ebook with 20 stories starting from Creation
In-app reader for the Bible stories
Generate one combined PDF ebook download containing all 20 stories
Automatically generate audio narration for stories
Include kid-friendly color pages throughout the ebook for coloring
Persist the ebook’s story metadata/content in the Motoko backend so the frontend loads the list of stories and their data from the canister (not hardcoded only in the UI).
